content_sections.body: Read this model: 'I have considered reasons and examples, and my experience shows one useful reason for this view.' Identify the main point, the linking expression, and the supporting detail. Then explain how the wording helps the speaker achieve this objective: Develop an opinion with a reason and a relevant example.
content_sections.title: Notice the connected language (10 minutes)

content_sections.body: Work with a partner in a discussion about reasons and examples. Give a clear main point, support it with a specific reason, and respond to one follow-up question. Use tactful language when the other speaker presents a different perspective.
content_sections.title: Guided exchange (10 minutes)

content_sections.body: Prepare a one-minute response about reasons and examples. Organize it into thought groups, stress the words that carry your main point, and finish with a concise conclusion rather than a list of isolated sentences.
content_sections.title: Independent connected response (8 minutes)
